explication: Activity Launcher lets users browse installed packages and their activities, inspect activity details, then launch an activity or create/share a shortcut. It also provides favorites, recents, package scanning, settings, and plugin-based launch/shortcut integrations. The graph follows documented and excerpted calls; several UI and use-case links are necessarily omitted because their implementations were not sampled.
